name: Can any tub be removed, or are there bathrooms that make it difficult?
description: Most tubs can be removed, but tight access, old plumbing, and surrounding tile or drywall can make the job more complex and expensive.

mainEntity.name: Can any tub be removed, or are there bathrooms that make it difficult?

acceptedAnswer.text: You usually need basic access to the bathroom, a clear path for debris removal, and confirmation of whether plumbing disconnects or wall repair are included. If the tub is in a tight space or the bathroom is older, the job may require extra demo to get the tub out safely.
